answer: Remove the per-head subsidy and sybils stop paying. In the Marble registry, reward equals bonded stake over total stake, with no signup grant or multiplier. Splitting a million PoA into ten thousand 100-PoA identities earns the same share but burns 25 PoA per registration (250,000) and pays ten thousand verification bills an epoch. The Nebula budget of 40,000 PoA reaches only stakes locked 30 epochs, so capital cannot be counted twice; the Summit rule keeps vote weight linear in stake, so a fragmented cartel gains nothing. Cost rises with identity count; payoff stays flat.
